title: City station readings (hourly), Environment Monitoring Unit
summary: Hourly NO2 and PM2.5 concentrations (ug/m3) from the city's own monitoring stations, one row per station per hour, keyed by station_id and ts_utc. The catalog gives an approximate 4.2 million rows, starts 2023-01-01 and is open-ended, refreshed hourly (last refreshed 2026-10-14). It covers the city's station network only, so it cannot serve the 2004-2005 prototype window, but it does span the 2024-2025 production window for stations other than VR-03, which the wiki says stopped reporting on 2024-06-30. No sample was read because access is by request.

documentation_excerpts: Hourly NO2 and PM2.5 readings from the city's own monitoring stations. (catalog description)
Station VR-03 (Via Roma) was switched off on 2024-06-30. Its readings stop there. (wiki station_network, last_edited 2024-07-01)
airq.station_readings still lists the network as active. Station VR-03 has no readings after 2024-06-30. (wiki station_network, last_edited 2024-07-01)
The other stations report continuously from 2023-01-01. (wiki station_network, last_edited 2024-07-01)
quality_notes: Station VR-03 has no readings after 2024-06-30 (wiki station_network, 2024-07-01), so the production window is only partly covered for that station; catalog metadata (last_refreshed 2026-10-14, status active, end null) does not mention it.

Catalog and wiki disagree on the network's status: the wiki says the catalog lists the network as active, and the catalog entry does show status 'active' with open-ended coverage, while the wiki says VR-03 is off since 2024-06-30. The catalog itself does not record the station closure.
Catalog temporal_coverage starts 2023-01-01, so the 2004-2005 prototype window (N1 prototype) is not covered.
No PM10 column, although the need asks for NO2 or PM2.5 only (N1 is satisfied by either).
No station coordinates, so the join to hourly weather or traffic by location is not documented.
No sample was read: access is by request to the Environment Monitoring Unit and no warehouse access was tested.
Row count is approximate (4.2 million) and no size in bytes is stated.
